# Clean Code for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/clean-code/ in the guided-plugins repository.

- Skills: 31 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$clean-code:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 22 roles in `../agents/clean-code-*.toml`. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so install them with `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs clean-code`.
- Always-on rules: see `../../rules/clean-code/`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
